title: Fast Muscle-Driven Whole-Body Motion Tracking with a Differentiable World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.33460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tracking motion capture with a whole-body musculoskeletal model means coordinating hundreds of muscles through contact, and current controllers take hours to days of GPU time to train, so every tuning decision is expensive. SuperMimic trains a tracking policy by backpropagating through the rollouts of a learned world model. We extend it to MS-Human-700 (700 muscles) and MyoFullBody (354 muscles), with MuJoCo's activation dynamics inside the world model. To make its training fast, our recipe takes the speedups developed for the Unitree G1, replaces three of their settings that fail on muscles, and adds four changes of our own: observations without muscle geometry, data collection concurrent with the updates, Beta exploration noise that keeps every excitation in $[0,1]$, and 50 Hz control. On one RTX 5090 it trains MS-Human-700 in 6.3 minutes to the held-out return that SuperMimic's published hyperparameters reach in 3.9 hours, 37$\times$

translated_title: 基于可微分世界模型的快速肌肉驱动全身运动跟踪
translated_abstract: 使用全身肌骨骼模型进行动作捕捉跟踪意味着需要通过接触来协调数百块肌肉，而现有的控制器需要数小时甚至数天的GPU训练时间，导致每一次调参决策都非常昂贵。SuperMimic通过在学习到的世界模型推演过程上进行反向传播来训练跟踪策略。我们将其扩展到 MS-Human-700（700块肌肉）和 MyoFullBody（354块肌肉），并将 MuJoCo 的激活动力学纳入世界模型中。为了实现快速训练，我们的方案借鉴了为 Unitree G1 开发的加速技术，替换了其中三项在肌肉模型上失效的设置，并新增四项改进：不包含肌肉几何信息的观测、数据采集与更新同步进行、确保每次激励保持在 [0,1] 区间的 Beta 探索噪声，以及 50 Hz 控制。在一块 RTX 5090 上，我们的方法仅需 6.3 分钟即可将 MS-Human-700 训练到 SuperMimic 公开超参数需要 3.9 小时才能达到的保留集回报，实现了 37 倍的加速。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于可微分世界模型的快速肌肉驱动全身运动跟踪方法，通过四项训练改进将 MS-Human-700 的训练时间从 3.9 小时缩短至 6.3 分钟，实现 37 倍加速。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fast muscle-driven whole-body motion tracking method based on a differentiable world model, which through four training improvements achieves a 37× speedup, training MS-Human-700 in 6.3 minutes instead of 3.9 hours.
